$comment: Published learning packs — public repos installable with `npm run pack:use <repo>`. PRs adding community packs welcome: the repo must contain a pack.json/questions.json that passes `npm run pack:validate`.

packs.title: Claude Cert Practice
packs.description: Claude Certified Architect (Foundations) exam practice — agentic architecture, Claude Code, prompt engineering, tools & MCP, context management. Curated from MIT-licensed community question banks, with per-question attribution.

packs.title: Claude Architect – Professional
packs.description: Unofficial Claude Certified Architect – Professional (CCAR-P) practice — multiple-choice and multiple-response questions across the seven exam domains, with rationales.

packs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
packs.description: Unofficial hard-mode practice for AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP-C02): multi-account governance, hybrid networking, migrations, DR, security, data, and cost trade-offs.

packs.title: AWS GenAI Developer Pro
packs.description: Practice for the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01) exam — foundation model integration, RAG, agents, prompt management, security, and observability on AWS.

packs.title: Music Theory Practice
packs.description: Visual music-theory practice — read staves, key signatures, intervals and chords. 102 questions across five categories and three levels (Beginner → Advanced); 84 carry generated staff and keyboard diagrams, and four answer with images.

packs.title: Capitals of the World
packs.description: Expert-level practice on the capital cities of the world — moved capitals (Astana, Naypyidaw, Nusantara), multiple-capital countries (South Africa, Bolivia, the Netherlands), and the ones map buffs reliably get wrong. 45 questions across five continents.
